name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 11 – Am 55
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 11d. Demands that securing the EU’s external borders must be a top priority in the 2026 EU budget, with a focus on preventing illegal migration and stopping the activities of human trafficking networks; calls for stronger financial and operational support for front-line Member States’ border protection efforts, particularly those most affected by migratory pressures, while ensuring that border security remains the sovereign responsibility of national authorities;
